tools.name: accept_ai_pack_terms
tools.description: Record the current account agreement required before creating, uploading, auditioning, or publishing a pack.

tools.name: search_ai_packs
tools.description: Search the published agent-asset exchange by task or capability.

tools.name: list_owned_ai_packs
tools.description: List purchased, claimed-free, and seller-owned packs available to this account.

tools.name: acquire_free_ai_pack
tools.description: Create a revocable entitlement for a published free pack without Stripe.

tools.name: download_ai_pack
tools.description: Return a short-lived entitlement-gated URL for the signed .taip envelope.

tools.name: get_ai_pack_report
tools.description: Read the buyer-safe, version-bound Agent AVCP gates and scores for a published pack.

tools.name: list_agent_models
tools.description: List OpenAI, Claude, and Z.AI models, current server pricing, capabilities, BYOK support, and sample Point quotes.

tools.name: get_ai_pack_runtime_profile
tools.description: Return the Pack-declared hosted skills, ephemeral attachment policy, and user-controlled MCP/API extensions before a run.

tools.name: quote_agent_run
tools.description: Get the exact worst-case Point reservation before using platform-funded inference. BYOK quotes zero model points.

tools.name: run_ai_pack
tools.description: Run a Tetrees AI Pack. Before acquisition, Points fund a stateless base preview. Ownership unlocks BYOK, saved growth and download; local files remain request-scoped.

tools.name: prepare_local_ai_pack_run
tools.description: Return a host-readable execution plan for connecting this Pack to explicitly selected, Agent-AVCP-auditioned local skills, MCP tools, resources, prompts, or HTTPS APIs. Tetrees does not execute client extensions on its hosted servers.

tools.name: execute_client_extension
tools.description: Execute one method from an owned Pack through a user-configured HTTPS API, nested MCP server, or isolated local-skill child process. Configuration and credentials stay in the local MCP process. Write methods require an exact one-call confirmation.

tools.name: propose_ai_pack_growth
tools.description: Select a proposal from a successful run. This creates a reviewable delta and does not mutate the pack.

tools.name: accept_ai_pack_growth
tools.description: Normalize a proposed delta with Tetrees Agent or provider-free portable normalization, run the deterministic growth gate, and append it to this owner only.

tools.name: list_ai_pack_growth
tools.description: List growth checkpoints, the active checkpoint, hosted slot/byte usage and limits without exposing private memory contents.

tools.name: select_ai_pack_growth_version
tools.description: Set this account's default hosted intelligence checkpoint for an owned Pack. Use sequence 0 to return to the signed base Pack; selection never rewrites the seller Pack.

tools.name: create_ai_pack_draft
tools.description: Create an owner-bound AI Pack listing with the complete buyer guide and two concrete example uses. Accept current terms first. Free drafts do not require Stripe Connect.

tools.name: update_ai_pack_draft
tools.description: Update seller-owned public metadata; immutable pack versions are never overwritten.

tools.name: upload_ai_pack
tools.description: Read an explicit local .taip path, transfer it through the product-scoped private upload contract, and commit one immutable higher version.

tools.name: upload_ai_pack_image
tools.description: Upload one explicit local JPEG, PNG, WebP, or AVIF image to the seller-owned pack listing.

tools.name: get_ai_pack_submission_readiness
tools.description: Return missing TAIP, metadata, and imagery requirements with exact next actions.

tools.name: submit_ai_pack_for_audition
tools.description: Move a complete owner-bound draft into the immutable Agent AVCP queue after readiness passes.

tools.name: quote_ai_pack_audition
tools.description: Return exact version-bound Point quotes and Agent AVCP deliverables.

tools.name: run_ai_pack_audition
tools.description: Run version-bound integrity, model, regression, memory-isolation, injection, growth, and cost gates after explicit Point confirmation.

tools.name: get_ai_pack_private_report
tools.description: Read actionable owner-only failures and next actions without exposing them to buyers.

tools.name: publish_ai_pack
tools.description: Publish the exact current version after every mandatory Agent AVCP gate passes. Paid packs additionally need Stripe Connect before checkout.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "quote_agent_run" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Get the exact worst-case Point reservation before using platform-funded inference. BYOK quotes zero model points.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "execute_client_extension" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
